author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The AI generated daily scrum report is finally useful.   I can quickly catch up on my team's progress after coming back from vacation.

I feed the daily scrum reports markdown files to both Opus 4.6 (Claude Code) and GPT-5.4 (Codex), just ask them to give me an update on my team's progress while I was away, like I am talking to a human assistant.

I like the report from Opus better, it sounds more human, but the one from GPT-5.4 is pretty good too, but sounds a bit dry.
